Madonna anchors the persona-pop side of the lane because reinvention, dancefloor address, and visual authorship are as diagnostic as the hooks.
Listen for an immediately legible chorus plus a performer identity that is inseparable from the record; that combination separates this lane from general adult pop or R&B crossover.

render_seed.short_definition: Mass-media pop sovereignty built from huge hooks, star persona, video-era image, and album events.
render_seed.history_capsule: This route follows the moment when Michael Jackson, Prince, Madonna, Whitney Houston, and peers turned pop into a global audiovisual language.

render_seed.what_made_it_distinct: The records feel engineered for public recognition, but the strongest examples still carry a very specific performer signature.
did_you_know: This lane is not just hit pop; it asks whether the artist identity is part of the song signal.
Prince is useful here as a bridge because the pop surface often carries funk and rock architecture underneath.
render_seed.caution: Do not use a generic popular-music source alone; this archetype needs star/persona and example-object support.
